name: Tidal Council
subtitle: Threshold multisig
description: Example 8 — K-of-N multisig with off-chain signature collection. One execute leaves a single state slot; domain separation blocks replay across chains and instances.
long_description: A minimal threshold wallet. Owners collect signatures off-chain (personal_sign over a domain-separated hash) and anyone relays the bundled execute transaction. Strictly ascending owner signatures reject duplicates, invalid sigs and unsorted bundles in one comparison; replay is blocked three ways — executed-hash ledger, chainId in the domain, and contract address in the domain. Static owner set: no upgrade or owner-change surface to attack. Failed target calls revert the whole execution with the return data.
